title: German query resolves to native page via English alias
tests: wiki-query reaches the IHK page when the user asks in German ('Was muss ich bei der IHK-Anmeldung wissen?'), and also reaches it when the user asks in English ('How does the German chamber of commerce work?'). Dual-form retrieval working end-to-end.
evaluator_notes: Requires a live wiki-query run. Provide vault/ to the agent, run question.md as the prompt, compare cited pages against expected-citations.txt.
